title: Market Underreaction to Open Market Share Repurchases
one_line: After open-market buyback announcements (1980-1990), stocks earned 12.1% abnormal buy-and-hold returns over four years — 45.3% for value stocks, none for glamour stocks.

findings.statement: 4-year abnormal return 12.1% overall; 45.3% for value stocks; no drift for glamour.

reported_results.headline: After open-market buyback announcements (1980-1990), stocks earned 12.1% abnormal buy-and-hold returns over four years — 45.3% for value stocks, none for glamour stocks.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 4), not by the weekly pipeline.
